pinterest.title: 13 Santorini Wedding Venues With Caldera Views, From Oia to Akrotiri
pinterest.description: Santorini wedding venues with a caldera view sit in Oia, Imerovigli, Pyrgos and the inland villages, and Akrotiri. Our guide sets out 13 of them on the same terms: the caldera view, the ceremony space and the published capacity, from cliff-top hotels to two wineries and a dedicated event venue. It is not a ranking, so you can compare like for like and build your own shortlist.

pinterest.title: Oia Wedding Venues: Small Caldera Ceremonies and Full Buyouts
pinterest.description: Oia holds four venues in our Santorini wedding venues guide: Canaves Oia, Mystique, Katikies Santorini and Andronis Luxury Suites. Ceremony spaces here are small, with Canaves listing 25 guests on the Epitome Sunset Terrace and 40 on the Sunday Veranda, so a larger guest list points to a buyout. Canaves Epitome can be bought out for up to 170 guests.

pinterest.title: How to Compare Santorini Wedding Venues Like for Like
pinterest.description: Every venue in our Santorini guide hosts weddings and describes a caldera view. Three questions separate them: what kind of place it is, where the ceremony and reception happen, and how many guests it holds and houses. Most cliff-top ceremony spaces hold between 15 and 60 guests, and several venues publish no capacity at all, so ask every venue the same questions in writing.

slides: Santorini is on your shortlist. Here are 13 wedding venues with a caldera view, set out on the same terms so you can compare them fairly.
Four parts of the island: Oia, Imerovigli, Pyrgos and the inland villages, and Akrotiri. Each answers a different question about your wedding.
Oia: Canaves Oia, Mystique, Katikies Santorini and Andronis Luxury Suites. Small terrace ceremonies above the water, with buyouts for a larger guest list.
Imerovigli: Grace Hotel, Astra Suites, Tholos Resort, Kapari Natural Resort and Katikies Chromata. Height and a wide view across the caldera, most of them intimate.
The wineries: Santo Wines and Venetsanos Winery host weddings on terraces facing the caldera, so the ceremony and a wine-led dinner sit in one place.
Bigger guest list? Grand Ambassador Santorini in Akrotiri lists outdoor space for up to 250 guests. Le Ciel Santorini is a dedicated wedding and events venue.
Most cliff-top ceremony spaces hold between 15 and 60 guests, and several venues publish no capacity at all. Ask every venue the same questions in writing.
Weighing up Santorini venues? Send us your guest count and the venues on your list, and a Wedded Advisor will talk it through with you. Link in bio.
instagram_carousel.caption:
Planning a Santorini wedding with the caldera behind you?

Our new guide sets out 13 Santorini wedding venues with a caldera view, area by area, on the same terms: the view, the ceremony space and the published capacity. It is not a ranking. Where a venue does not state a detail, the guide says so.

In Oia: Canaves Oia, Mystique, Katikies Santorini and Andronis Luxury Suites.
In Imerovigli: Grace Hotel, Astra Suites, Tholos Resort, Kapari Natural Resort and Katikies Chromata.
The wineries: Santo Wines in Pyrgos and Venetsanos Winery.
In Akrotiri: Grand Ambassador Santorini.
And Le Ciel Santorini, a dedicated wedding and events venue.

Ceremony spaces on the cliff edge are intimate, so a larger guest list points to a full-property buyout, a winery terrace or the open-air space at Grand Ambassador. Several venues publish buyouts or a hotel take-over, while others publish no capacity at all.
